candidate.claim: CancelToken executor guard is inverted: it returns when no cancellation exists so reason is never set and cancel never works
candidate.title: CancelToken cancel guard inverted

verifier.reason: The guard at cancel/CancelToken.js:55 returns when token.reason is falsy, which is the initial state, so the assignments at cancel/CancelToken.js:60-61 are unreachable on first cancel and cancellation never takes effect.

candidate.claim: settle resolves any status <500 even when validateStatus returns false, so 4xx errors incorrectly resolve
candidate.title: settle bypasses validateStatus for status <500

verifier.reason: The condition at core/settle.js:16 includes '|| response.status < 500' as an independent disjunct, so a 4xx response resolves at core/settle.js:17 even when validateStatus(response.status) is false.

candidate.claim: spread passes the array as a single argument instead of spreading it, breaking f(x,y,z) usage
candidate.title: spread does not spread array arguments

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/spread.js:26 uses callback.apply(null, [arr]), which passes the whole array as the single first argument instead of spreading its elements, contradicting the documented spread(function(x, y, z) {})([1, 2, 3]) usage at helpers/spread.js:17.

candidate.claim: combineURLs concatenates without inserting '/' so base without trailing slash plus relative produces missing separator
candidate.title: combineURLs missing slash separator

verifier.reason: The return at helpers/combineURLs.js:22 concatenates baseURL.slice(0, end) after stripping trailing slashes at helpers/combineURLs.js:18-20 directly with relativeURL after stripping leading slashes, inserting no '/' separator.

candidate.claim: isAxiosError checks !== false so any plain object without the flag is reported as AxiosError
candidate.title: isAxiosError returns true for non-errors

verifier.reason: The code at helpers/isAxiosError.js:13 returns utils.isObject(payload) && payload.isAxiosError !== false, so a plain object lacking the property (undefined !== false) yields true.

candidate.claim: buildURL keeps '#' when stripping fragment so serialized params are appended after fragment instead of as query
candidate.title: buildURL retains hash when appending params

verifier.reason: At helpers/buildURL.js:63 the URL is sliced to hashmarkIndex + 1, retaining '#', and helpers/buildURL.js:65 then appends the serialized params after it, so params fall in the fragment rather than the query string.

candidate.claim: throttle timer callback invokes stale captured args instead of latest lastArgs, dropping updates coalesced while throttled
candidate.title: throttle replays stale args instead of lastArgs

verifier.reason: The timer at helpers/throttle.js:31-33 invokes the per-call captured args, while later coalesced calls only update lastArgs at helpers/throttle.js:29, and invoke clears lastArgs at helpers/throttle.js:15, so the latest coalesced update is dropped.
